title: SMTP: RCPT TO address allows unescaped > injection
description: smtp/src/relay.rs constructs RCPT TO commands by interpolating the recipient address without stripping or escaping '>'. An address containing '>' would terminate the SMTP argument early and allow injection of additional SMTP commands into the relay session. Fix: validate recipient addresses to RFC 5321 mailbox syntax before building the RCPT TO line, or at minimum reject any address containing '>'. This is a P2 because the relay only accepts addresses from operator-controlled Sieve rules, but defense-in-depth requires sanitization at the SMTP command boundary.
